module_summary: Combinational bridge from PicoRV32 native memory bus to AXI4-lite master, using per-channel accepted flags and a transfer-done flag to issue each AW/W/AR request once.

anchors.name: mem_valid
anchors.why: Native request valid; gates all AXI valids, readies and clears accepted flags.

anchors.name: mem_ready
anchors.why: Native completion, asserted on AXI write response or read data valid.

anchors.name: mem_wstrb
anchors.why: Nonzero strobe selects AXI write channels; zero selects read channels.

anchors.name: mem_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write-address valid, suppressed once ack_awvalid set.

anchors.name: mem_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI write-data valid, suppressed once ack_wvalid set.

anchors.name: mem_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read-address valid for reads, suppressed once ack_arvalid set.

anchors.name: ack_awvalid
anchors.why: Records AW handshake accepted; blocks reissuing awvalid until transfer ends.

anchors.name: ack_wvalid
anchors.why: Records W handshake accepted; blocks reissuing wvalid until transfer ends.

anchors.name: ack_arvalid
anchors.why: Records AR handshake accepted; blocks reissuing arvalid until transfer ends.

anchors.name: xfer_done
anchors.why: Registered native completion; clears all channel accepted flags.

anchors.name: mem_addr
anchors.why: Native address forwarded to both AXI awaddr and araddr.

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Read data passed through from AXI rdata.

anchors.name: mem_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Write data passed through from native mem_wdata.

anchors.name: mem_axi_arprot
anchors.why: Marks instruction fetches via mem_instr in AXI protection bits.

groups.name: channel_tracking
groups.description: Accepted flags per AXI request channel, cleared on transfer done or idle.

groups.name: request_issue
groups.description: Maps native request to AXI AW/W or AR channels by write strobe.

groups.name: response_return
groups.description: AXI B/R responses complete native transfer and return read data.
